label: A Field Trip to the Maid Cafe

lines.text: *Clap*

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Okay, everyone.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Today, we're going on a field trip.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: A field trip? Seems kinda sudden.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: We're not going up to the surface... are we?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: No, it's nothing like that.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: We need to really start preparing for the festival.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Since our class decided to open up a mini maid cafe,

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: we'll be learning about what's involved and doing some hands-on training.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Whoa!

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: So the field trip is to a maid cafe?

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: We're going to a m-maid cafe...?!

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: I'll finally have the chance to show off my charms...!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: We received special approval for this at the request of myself and Mr. {AccountData.NickName}.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: So you all need to stay focused.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Understood?

lines.speaker: students
lines.text: Yes, Miss Privaty!
We take the class and head to the maid cafe.
*Jingle*

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: Welcome, Privaty, Master.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: And welcome to our little maid trainees!

lines.speaker: students
lines.text: Hello!

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Who's she calling little...?

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: I'm not talking about appearance.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: I'm referring to your skills and proficiency as a maid.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Wait, you heard me?!

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: I barely even heard myself...

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: A professional maid must always be able to hear her master's voice.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: It's a basic skill that we all must possess.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Wow...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Thank you for taking the time to help us. I'm sure you're busy.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: No need to thank me. Training maids is part of my job!

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: Okay, first off,

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: I'll give a demonstration of how the pros do it.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: Privaty, Master! Over here, please.
I casually sit down on the chair that's there,
and Privaty very naturally approaches me.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Welcome back, Master.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Is there anything you'd like to order?
What do you recommend?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Personally, I'd recommend the omurice.
Okay, I'll have that.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Would you like a drink to go with it?
Hmm... I'll take a cream soda.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Very well. I'll get that for you right away.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Wow...

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Are we supposed to be that curt, though?

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: I thought we'd have to be a bit softer and sweeter.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: It all depends on the individual maid.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: There are some who are gentle and sweet, like Ade,

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: and then there are others who are more aloof, like Privaty.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: Different types of maids are popular with different customers.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Aha...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Your omurice is ready.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: What message would you like written on it?
Privaty ♡ {AccountData.NickName}.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: ... Ahem. V-very well.
*Splurt, splurt*

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Here you go.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: And now, lastly...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: would you like me to cast the... d-d-delicious spell?
Of course!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Be...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Become tastier! Become tastier!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: C-coochie woochie, boing...!
Coochie woochie, boing!

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: This is not going to be easy...

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Agreed...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Whew...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: That's just about all there is to it.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Do you all think you can do that?

lines.speaker: students
lines.text: Yeah...!

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: All right, let's get into it. First, greetings.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: Clasp your hands right at your waist!

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: Then slowly bow at a 45-degree angle.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Like this...?

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: No jerky movements! It has to be a straight, smooth bow.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: Wow, you're pretty good at this!
The students are doing their best, despite not being used to this sort of thing.
You hadn't done this in a while, but you still did great.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Y-yeah, of course!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: No matter what I do, I give it my best.
Was it awkward having to do that in front of the students?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Wh-what would be awkward about it?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I've never hidden the fact that I worked at a maid cafe.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: If I were embarrassed about it, I wouldn't have organized an event like this in the first place.
A professional answer from a professional maid.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Don't tease me.
As time passes and everyone relaxes,
the students start to really enjoy themselves.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Coochie woochie, boinggg!

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Ugh, I can't do it.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Become tastier! Naru Naru, wheeee!
The trip to the maid cafe ends up being a resounding success.
After school...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: You did great today.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: We're going to have a drink together, right?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Let's go to my room.
Sure.
We stop by a nearby convenience store to grab some beer, then head to Privaty's room.
*Thack! Fizz...*
The pop of the beer can echoes loudly.
Cheers!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Cheers.
*Gulp, gulp*

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Ahhh...
So, what was that special dessert you mentioned?
Want something to eat? I brought some food.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Oh, this.
Privaty brings out some mini cakes decorated with cute cartoon characters.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: These characters are really popular right now.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: A lot of students have keychains of them on their bags.
Aww, that's cute.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Right? Especially this one.
No, I meant you're cute for being so into this.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Wh-what...? Are you drunk already?
Maybe.
I move slightly closer to Privaty.
Personally, I'm more interested in this snack right here.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: J-just a second...!
*Peck*
Mmm... That's really sweet.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: S-s-stop...!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I'm still too sober for that...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: It's really embarrassing...
I thought by now we'd spent enough time together,
but it looks like we still have to rely on alcohol...
All right. If that's how it's gonna be,
I guess we need to drink some...
Suddenly, the door opens.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Oh, wow. Did I interrupt something?

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Should I come back later?
I'm still right next to Privaty when, without warning,
Ether barges in.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Sure, sounds good.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: What did you bring?
Pizza and chicken.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: That's a bit much for two people, no?
You say that, but we always end up eating everything once we start drinking.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: That's true.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Whew... I drank quite a bit yesterday, so I didn't think I'd be able to drink much today,

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: but it turns out I was wrong.
That's because drinking alone and drinking together are very different.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Hmm.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: So you're saying it's all thanks to you that I'm able to drink more?
Yep.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: That's quite the statement.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Admittedly, though,

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: alcohol does taste better when you're not drinking alone.
Right?
... What can I do to help us go from being drinking buddies to something more?
I don't think getting hammered together is the answer.
I glance sideways at Privaty.
Aren't you uncomfortable in that outfit? You can change if you want. We're in your room after all.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Oh... That's okay.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: It'll take too long for me to shower and change.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I'm not going to drink that much anyway, so I'm fine like this.
That didn't work...
In that case, do you mind lending me something more comfy to wear?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: There's no way my clothes would fit you.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: If you're uncomfortable, just go change. Your room's close enough.
Oh... Nah, never mind.
Nothing's working...
Why are you being so indifferent to me?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Wh-what...?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: What's with all the weird questions all of a sudden?
Weird? Ouch...
Here we go. It may not have been exactly how I planned, but the mood's getting a little better.
From here, we should...
Suddenly, the door opens.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Oh wow, are you two drinking together?

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Mind if I join?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: G-gahhh!
... Ether?!
Before we have time to react,
Ether waltzes on in.
